correctness.rationale: An explicit invertible path-cumulative linear map to the full type-A root polytope proves every facet. Direct dual norm computation gives exact support-plane distances, tight opposite facets bound the inball, and strict remaining slack proves its center-set dimension. Antipodal longest vertices prove the minimum sphere. Symmetry and convex matrix-inverse averaging prove sharp John/Loewner ellipsoids and BM factor for all affine ellipsoids. Verified exact rational 15 configs d=2..6; finite checks do not replace the infinite proof.
